predecessors.name: French Mandate for Syria and the Lebanon
predecessors.text: Greater Lebanon, established 1 September 1920 under French control: 'the regions of Mount Lebanon, North Lebanon, South Lebanon, and the Bekaa, with Beirut as its designated capital'

ledger.x: 22 November 1943: Lebanon declares independence from France.
ledger.cpn: French Mandate for Syria and the Lebanon

ledger.x: 23 March 1949: Lebanon and Israel sign the armistice (Syria signed on 20 July 1949), ending the fighting along the frontier.
31 May 1976: the Syrian army enters Lebanon.
June 1982: Israeli forces reach the Beirut area.
14 June 1982: the siege of Beirut begins.
3 September 1983: Israel withdraws south of the Awali.
June 1985: Israel pulls back to a security zone.
1 October 2006: Israel withdraws from Lebanon except Ghajar.

wars.name: 1948 Arab-Israeli War
wars.outcome: Lebanon seized two villages on 15 May 1948 and lost al-Malkiyya and southern Lebanon; Israel withdrew from 13 Lebanese villages under the armistice of 23 March 1949, which followed the international boundary.

wars.name: Lebanese Civil War
wars.outcome: 'A full-scale civil war broke out in Lebanon'; it 'ended at the end of 1990 after 16 years'.

wars.name: 1978 Israeli invasion of Lebanon
wars.outcome: Israel invaded after the Fatah bus hijacking of 11 March 1978 and occupied most of the area south of the Litani; UN Resolution 425 created UNIFIL; Israeli forces withdrew later in 1978 but kept a security zone.

wars.name: 1982 Lebanon War
wars.outcome: Israel invaded on 6 June 1982, besieged Beirut from 14 June, left west Beirut on 29 September, retreated south of the Awali on 3 September 1983 and withdrew to the security zone in June 1985.

wars.name: South Lebanon conflict (1985-2000)
wars.outcome: Israel and the South Lebanon Army held the security zone until the withdrawal of 24-25 May 2000; the UN found on 16 June 2000 that Israel had withdrawn from all of Lebanon; Lebanon claims the Shebaa Farms.

wars.name: 2006 Lebanon War
wars.outcome: War of 12 July to 14 August 2006; most Israeli troops left on 1 October; Israel kept Ghajar.

wars.name: 2024 Israel-Hezbollah war
wars.outcome: Israel invaded on 1 October 2024; a ceasefire in November 2024 ended 13 months of conflict and obliged Israeli forces to withdraw over 60 days.

certainty.note: The frontier with Palestine and Israel is the mandate boundary, confirmed by the armistice line of 23 March 1949; the frontier with Syria is not described on the pages read.
Syrian and Israeli occupation lines: the security zone and the Syrian-held north and east are approximate.
The Israeli frontier is the UN-certified withdrawal line of 16 June 2000; Shebaa Farms and Ghajar are disputed.
